title: Lin Dong Versus Lin Langtian
summary: Lin Dong turns the Taotie's devouring back on Song Zhen and defeats him, and the brothers take the Song brothers' Nirvana Seals. Lin Dong rises to eighth place, and the top 24 teleport to Baichao Mountain. There Wu Dao's clone asks Lin Dong to join the Dao Sect, and Lin Dong asks for time to think. Liu Tong of the Yuan Gate explains the Nirvana Ranking battle, where the top three may choose their sect and past champions have all joined the Yuan Gate. The first-round draw pits Lin Dong against Lin Langtian. Lin Langtian lets a primordial spirit inside him merge with him and takes a Yimo form with ancient Yimo martial arts. Lin Dong holds him off with the Devouring Ancestral Symbol's power and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand.
events: Lin Dong devours Song Zhen's power and defeats him.
With the Song brothers' seals Lin Dong rises to eighth and reaches the final 24.
The finalists teleport to Baichao Mountain, while Western Xuan agents prepare their plan.
Wu Dao's clone invites Lin Dong to join the Dao Sect.
Liu Tong explains the rules: any means, life or death not counted.
The draw sets Lin Dong against Lin Langtian.
Lin Langtian merges with a primordial spirit and fights with Yimo martial arts.
Lin Dong counters with Devouring Power and the Great Desolate martial spirit.
cultivation: Lin Langtian merges with a primordial spirit awakened inside him and takes a Yimo form, multiplying his strength.
